{{Use mdy dates|date=July 2025}}
'''Amelia M. Haviland''' is an American statistician currently the Anna Loomis McCandless Professor of Statistics and Public Policy at [[Carnegie Mellon University]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.heinz.cmu.edu/faculty-and-research/faculty-profiles/faculty-details/index.aspx?faculty_id=138 |title=Amelia Haviland |publisher=cmu.edu |accessdate=April 28, 2017}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=GNo5BrwAAAAJ&hl=en |title=Amelia Haviland |accessdate=April 28, 2017}}</ref> She was named a [[Fellow of the American Statistical Association]] in 2021.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.amstat.org/ASA/Your-Career/Awards/ASA-Fellows-list.aspx|title=ASA Fellows list|publisher=American Statistical Association|access-date=2021-07-04}}</ref>
